narrative.en: Independent exploration at the intersection of AI, developer tools, and creative technology. Building personal operating systems and experimenting with new forms of human-computer interaction.
narrative.zh: 在人工智能、开发者工具和创意技术的交汇处进行独立探索。构建个人操作系统，探索人机交互的新形式。

narrative.en: Leading the development of Lynx, a cross-platform UI framework powering experiences for billions of users across ByteDance's ecosystem.
narrative.zh: 领导 Lynx 跨平台 UI 框架的开发，为字节跳动生态系统中数十亿用户提供体验。

keywords.zh: 跨平台, React, 性能优化

narrative.en: Contributing to the React ecosystem during its formative years. Working on core features, performance optimizations, and helping shape the future of component-based UI development.
narrative.zh: 在 React 生态系统的形成期做出贡献。参与核心功能开发、性能优化，帮助塑造基于组件的 UI 开发的未来。

narrative.en: Learning the craft of software engineering. Building web applications, exploring mobile development, and discovering the joy of creating things with code.
narrative.zh: 学习软件工程的技艺。构建网络应用，探索移动开发，发现用代码创造事物的乐趣。

keywords.zh: 网页开发, 移动端, 学习

description.en: A personal operating system — ambient, contextual, AI-native.
description.zh: 个人操作系统 —— 环境感知、上下文感知、AI 原生。

commentary.en: The portfolio as living software. Not a resume, but a surface.
commentary.zh: 作品集即活的软件。不是简历，而是一个界面。

title.zh: 与 AI 共振的 UI

description.en: Exploring the future of human-AI collaboration in interface design.
description.zh: 探索人机协作在界面设计中的未来。

description.en: Why the framework wars might be ending, and what comes next.
description.zh: 为什么框架之战可能即将结束，以及接下来会发生什么。

description.en: Cross-platform UI framework powering TikTok, Douyin, and more.
description.zh: 为 TikTok、抖音等产品提供动力的跨平台 UI 框架。

commentary.en: The most impactful project of my career. Shipping to billions taught me what scale really means.
commentary.zh: 我职业生涯中最具影响力的项目。向数十亿用户交付让我理解了规模的真正含义。

title.zh: 字节跳动规模的跨平台开发

description.en: How we built and scaled Lynx to power experiences for billions.
description.zh: 我们如何构建和扩展 Lynx 以服务数十亿用户。

description.en: Leading architecture and developer experience for the Lynx platform.
description.zh: 领导 Lynx 平台的架构和开发者体验工作。

title.zh: 构建可扩展的设计系统

description.en: Lessons from building component libraries for massive teams.
description.zh: 为大规模团队构建组件库的经验教训。

description.en: Contributing to React's core features and performance.
description.zh: 为 React 核心功能和性能做出贡献。

commentary.en: Working on React taught me that good abstractions are worth fighting for.
commentary.zh: 在 React 上工作让我明白，好的抽象值得为之奋斗。

description.en: Introducing the future of React rendering.
description.zh: 介绍 React 渲染的未来。

description.en: Member of the React Core team working on framework fundamentals.
description.zh: React 核心团队成员，从事框架基础工作。

description.en: The project that started it all — a simple but meaningful beginning.
description.zh: 一切开始的地方 —— 简单但意义重大的开始。

commentary.en: Everyone starts somewhere. This was my somewhere.
commentary.zh: 每个人都有起点。这就是我的起点。
